# Independent five-row ViewportRuler review

The bounded five-row source-context proposal is supported for separate owner-controlled roster admission: capsule SHA-256 `d316dbefe73bf25f913df1b67d5491b60bc78f213f3bb6e4559899fdc2d4f6e7`, exact frozen-key delta SHA-256 `5a7b768961914abace951458cdb2b850f6d3708e74dbd3077cb874f438a04354`, additive capsule patch SHA-256 `35775b26e9c60a912e6989270454194fcd088b2badb43edf9d1c1b2764aee243`, and validation receipt SHA-256 `54f361bd0e2a6950edd0948865459073b8e0ace62b53defdab6ad47d59438b89`. No roster or ledger was changed by this review. The strict patch's complete afterimage equals the capsule and applies cleanly at inspected checkpoint 73bc0ee8c6f26d4f2a6b906109faecefcbd67dcf.

The five exact open frozen keys occur once in the 1,736-row seed and once in the unchanged 54-row predecessor; each predecessor row's canonical record hash matches its delta, and all five recorded source hashes match the current source and the predecessor. An independent run of `legacy-viewport-use-review.mjs` produced eight source cases and six direct/inherited call sites; the five selected exact bindings match the capsule. The sources import the owned `_LegacyViewport` alias, and the seed's CDK ViewportRuler key is historical. The peer CDK declaration is docs-private; this finding does not claim that peer API as stable public. The spinner's optional constructor parameter and the four tab constructor/forwarding positions are source facts, not proof of all component runtime behavior.

V2 resolves the initial linkage concern: each selected row now includes the exact unchanged predecessor file in `independent_evidence`. Independent invocation of the unchanged generic `authoredUseReviewEvidence` accepted exactly five proposed rows and rejected all five when the predecessor bytes changed, and rejected the affected row when its source changed (`generic-probe.log` SHA-256 `fef09d0ded2182025a7417072a30a91d23ce75227a646348dbe803b1a3e738b8`). Historical receipt contents remain historical; they are not reissued or reattributed as new runtime runs.

The full Git diff for the retained fixture correction changes only the progress-bar default-token assertion from inequality to equality; viewport imports, setup and checks are unchanged. The retained artifact SHA-256 `08dae37e775e2ab50457d820b3c7ae98114059012125781378cd36f05d8990e5` was rehashed; its tabs and progress-spinner source maps contain all five current source bytes exactly, and its core source map also matches the current owned viewport implementation and shared export. The retained original fixture and RxJS 6.5.3 minimum result files were rehashed; both have 106 passing cases and their named select and tabs cases pass with `viewportShared=true`. The harness checks shared owned viewport injector identity and reported width/height; it is a JSDOM/TestBed fixture, not native viewport coverage. The RxJS floor is one Node 24.15.0 linux-arm64, Angular/CDK/Material 22.1.7 configuration.

The proposal does not apply its five-key delta and does not rerun a packed build or browser. It does not qualify all eight historical viewport keys, a complete viewport behavioral suite, 21.x, all floors/platforms, G01–G13, security, release or full source audit. Integration must retain the exact predecessor and evidence, validate the current source frame, and apply only the explicitly reviewed five keys. No canonical files were changed.
